slogan: From the community, for the community
title: About us
subtitle: About the Healthy Seeb initiative: our vision, our mission and how the community and institutions work together towards a sustainable healthy wilayat.
introTitle: A healthy wilayat that raises the quality of life and puts people at the centre of development
introText: An accredited healthy-wilayat project that creates an environment supporting health and sustainable development, by empowering the local community and building integrated partnerships between the government, civil and private sectors in Wilayat Seeb.

vision.title: Our vision
vision.text: A comprehensive community development movement that aims to make Wilayat Seeb a national and regional model of a sustainable healthy city, built on social justice, healthy urban planning and active partnership between all sectors, reflecting the core pillars of Oman Vision 2040.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.text: Health is more than the absence of disease, and 80% of what determines our health is shaped outside the Ministry of Health and traditional healthcare. That is why Healthy Seeb follows a “Health in All Policies” approach: we bring different sectors together to improve public health, support sustainable urban growth and build an active community partnership that ensures a healthy, fair environment for everyone in the wilayat.

values.title: Sustainability
values.text: Urban and environmental planning that serves future generations

values.title: Participation
values.text: The community is a partner, not just a recipient

values.title: Fairness
values.text: A healthy, fair environment for every neighbourhood of the wilayat

affiliation.title: Global membership and strategic partnership
affiliation.text: The initiative is part of the Healthy Cities Network of the World Health Organization's Eastern Mediterranean Region (WHO/EMRO). The letter of cooperation and membership was officially signed on 10 December 2025, making Wilayat Seeb part of the global movement that strengthens cooperation between sectors to meet modern urban challenges.

executive.title: Executive committee
executive.subtitle: The executive committee was formed by administrative decision and is chaired by His Excellency the Wali of Seeb, to ensure the initiative's goals are delivered scientifically and in practice
